Superconducting Magnet.name: Niobium

Superconducting Magnet.name: Titanium
Superconducting Magnet.reasoning: Titanium is often used in structural support and cryostat components due to strength and low magnetic susceptibility; commonly used though some stainless steel alternatives exist.

Superconducting Magnet.name: Copper
Superconducting Magnet.reasoning: Copper is essential for stabilizer and conductor components in superconducting wires due to excellent electrical and thermal conductivity; universally used.

Superconducting Magnet.name: Helium
Superconducting Magnet.reasoning: Helium is the primary cryogen for cooling superconducting coils to maintain superconductivity; absolutely essential with no alternatives for MRI magnet cooling.
